APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 903
CONTENT:
Section 903 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety with the following
exceptions, modifications, and additions.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.903.1.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.903.1.2
TITLE: SPARE SPRINKLER HEADS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 300, 301, 000
CONTENT:
Automatic sprinkler systems shall be provided with spare sprinkler heads as
follows:

1. For systems with not over 300 sprinklers, provide six spare sprinkler
heads.

2. For systems with 301 to 1,000 sprinklers, provide 12 spare sprinkler
heads.

3. For systems with over 1,000 sprinklers, provide 24 spare sprinkler
heads.

These spare sprinkler heads shall correspond to the type and temperature
ratings of the sprinkler heads in the system. These sprinkler heads shall be
kept in a cabinet mounted in the vicinity of the sprinkler control valve or
other approved location if the control valve is outside the building. A wrench
suitable for the removal and installation of all sprinkler heads used shall be
kept in the cabinet.
---

APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 003
CONTENT:
Sprinkler heads located in spray rooms, spray booths, spray tunnels, or in
spraying areas shall be clean and protected from overspray residue.
Polyethylene or cellophane bags having a thickness of .003 inch or less or
paper bags of a similar thickness may be used to protect heads from overspray.
Such bags shall be replaced periodically to prevent the excessive buildup of
overspray.

SKIP: false

CONTENT:

---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.906.1.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.906.1.1
TITLE: PORTABLE FIRE EXTINGUISHERS FOR ASSEMBLY OCCUPANCIES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 000
CONTENT:
In Group A Occupancies, one additional Class 2A portable fire extinguisher
shall be provided as follows:

1. On each side of every stage or platform having an area greater than
1,000 square feet. Stages or platforms having an area of 1,000 square feet or
less shall be provided with one extinguisher.

2. On each side of every fly gallery.

3. In basements beneath the stage or platform.

4. In every hallway or passageway leading to a dressing room.

5. In every property room, carpenter shop, or similar room.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.906.1.1.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.906.1.1.1
TITLE: ADDITIONAL CLASS 10B:C EXTINGUISHER REQUIRED.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
One additional class 10B:C extinguisher shall be provided as follows:

1. In each kitchen.

2. In each electrical room.

3. Adjacent to each switchboard on any stage or platform.

4. For each motion picture machine in projection rooms. Minimum combined
rating for any projection room shall be 20B:C.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.906.1.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.906.1.2
TITLE: FIRE EXTINGUISHERS FOR INSTITUTIONAL OCCUPANCIES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Operating rooms in institutional occupancies shall have at least one class
10B:C extinguisher.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.906.2.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.906.2.2
TITLE: MAINTAINED READY FOR USE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Portable fire extinguishers shall be maintained in a fully charged and
operable condition and kept in their approved locations when not in use.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.906.2.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.906.2.3
TITLE: ACCESSIBILITY.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Portable fire extinguishers shall be conspicuously located where they will
be readily accessible and immediately available at all times. When it is not
practical to install extinguishers in a plainly visible location, signs or
other approved identification shall be provided to indicate the location.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.906.2.4
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.906.2.4
TITLE: INSTALLATION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Portable fire extinguishers shall be installed on hangers, in approved
brackets, or set in cabinets unless the extinguishers are of the wheeled type.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.906.2.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.906.2.5
TITLE: MOUNTING HEIGHT.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Portable fire extinguishers having a gross weight not exceeding 40 pounds
shall be installed so that the top of the extinguisher is not more than 5 feet
above the floor. Extinguishers having a gross weight greater than 40 pounds
(except wheeled type) shall be so installed that the top of the extinguisher is
not more than 3 1/2 feet above the floor. In no case shall the clearance
between the bottom of the extinguisher and the floor be less than 4 inches.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.906.2.6
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.906.2.6
TITLE: TEMPERATURE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 120
CONTENT:
Portable fire extinguishers should not be located where ambient temperatures
exceed 120°F unless otherwise noted on the nameplate of the extinguisher.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.906.2.7
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code

APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 575
CONTENT:

---

---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.907.2.13.2.1.1

SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Phone jacks shall be located in the following locations:

1. At every floor level in each enclosed exit stairway.

2. At every exterior location where an enclosed exit stairway exits to a
public way.

3. At the exterior of each enclosed exit stairway located on the roof.

4. In each elevator car, elevator machine room, elevator lobby, and each
lobby which exits to a public way.
---

---

---

SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
A minimum of six handheld phone sets with cords 6 feet in length shall be

---

CONTENT:

used for other announcements.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.907.6.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.907.6.1
TITLE: WIRING.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Wiring shall comply with the requirements of the California Electrical Code
and NFPA 72.

EXCEPTION: Exposed conductors or cables shall not be permitted.

Wireless protection systems utilizing radio-frequency transmitting devices
shall comply with the special requirements for supervision of low-power
wireless systems in NFPA 72.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.907.6.6.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.907.6.6.5
TITLE: PERMITS REQUIRED.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 105.6, 907.6
CONTENT:
No person shall maintain, operate, conduct, or contract with others to
engage in the operation of any central station signaling system supervising
station unless a valid permit as required by Section
57.105.6 has been issued and the operation of such system is done in compliance
with the provisions of Section 57.907.6.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.907.8.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.907.8.5
TITLE: MAINTENANCE OF EQUIPMENT.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
All fire protective signaling systems required by this section shall be
maintained in an operable condition at all times. Upon disruption or
diminishment of the fire protective qualities of such equipment, materials, or
systems, immediate action shall be instituted to affect a re- establishment of
such equipment, material, or systems to their original, normal, and operational
condition. Systems shall be tested annually and in accordance with approved
written test procedures in a manner satisfactory to the Chief. An accurate
record of such tests shall be kept by the owner of the property and such
records shall be open to examination by the Chief.
---

---

---

CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.918.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.918.1
TITLE: SCOPE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
This section shall set forth the requirements of a Fire Watch when the Chief
determines that a building or premises presents a hazard to life or property as
the result of a fire or other emergency, or when it is determined that any fire
protection equipment or system is inoperable, defective, or has been taken out
of service.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.918.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.918.2
TITLE: AUTHORITY TO REQUIRE FIRE WATCH.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The Chief may require implementation of a Fire Watch whenever it is deemed
necessary by the Chief to assure minimum fire/life safety as regulated by this
article. The Chief shall specify the number of Fire Watch personnel and duties
to be performed.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.918.2.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.918.2.1
TITLE: AUTHORITY OF THE CHIEF TO ASSIGN DEPARTMENT MEMBERS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Whenever the owner or person in charge does not provide Fire Watch personnel
as required, the Chief shall have the authority to assign uniformed Department
members until such time as required Fire Watch personnel are provided.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.918.2.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.918.2.2
TITLE: FIRE WATCH MAINTAINED UNTIL SAFE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
A Fire Watch shall be maintained until such time that the Chief determines
that the building or premises is safe from hazard to life or property, or when
fire protection equipment or systems are restored to service.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.918.2.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.918.2.3
TITLE: PENALTIES AND MINIMUM FINES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 918.2, 918.2.2, 110.4
CONTENT:
Violation of Sections
57.918.2 through
57.918.2.2 shall be subject to penalties and minimum fines as prescribed in
Section
57.110.4 and
Table 57.110.4.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.918.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.918.3
TITLE: RESPONSIBILITY FOR INSTRUCTION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The owner, manager, or person in charge or control of the building or
premises shall assign to the Fire Watch as many personnel as are required by
the Chief, and shall instruct Fire Watch personnel as to:

1. The procedure for notifying the Fire Department.

2. The area to be patrolled.

3. A method of alerting building occupants and an evacuation procedure.

Note: When two or more Fire Watch personnel are required, two-way radios may
be required by the Fire Department to facilitate communication and evacuation.

4. A procedure shall be provided for reactivating sprinkler valves in the
event of fire when the sprinkler system has been taken out of service, and any
other instruction required by the Chief.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.918.4
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.918.4
TITLE: LOG BOOK.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The owner, manager, or person in charge or control of the premises shall
provide a log book which contains a directory of names, telephone numbers, and
other information to assist in making emergency calls and calls to key
management personnel, and which shall be used to record a history of patrol
rounds.

The log book shall be maintained on the premises and be available for
inspection by the Department.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.918.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.918.5
TITLE: SPECIFIC DUTY REQUIREMENTS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Assigned Fire Watch personnel shall:

1. Be thoroughly familiar with the area they are patrolling;

2. Perform patrol operations according to instructions from management;

3. Patrol their designated area at least once each half hour; and

4. Make reports as instructed.

A written record of patrol rounds and any significant information shall be
recorded in a log book provided by management. Assigned Fire Watch personnel
shall also relay any special orders or pertinent information to relief
personnel and remain on duty until properly relieved.
---

---

SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Chapter 10 of the California Fire Code (CFC) is hereby adopted by reference
with the following exceptions, modifications, and additions.
---

SKIP: false

CROSS_REFERENCES: 1004

Section 1004 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety with the following

---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.1004.5.1.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.1004.5.1.1
TITLE: DETERMINATION OF OCCUPANT LOAD.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 1004.5.1.1.1, 1004.5.1.1.2
CONTENT:
The maximum occupant load for the use of any occupancy shall be determined
by Sections
57.1004.5.1.1.1 through
57.1004.5.1.1.2.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.1004.5.1.1.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.1004.5.1.1.1
TITLE: CHIEF’S APPROVAL REQUIRED.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The Chief shall determine the maximum occupant load permitted for any
assembly occupancy, or any portion of other occupancies used for assembly
purposes, based upon the provisions of this chapter. The maximum occupant load
shall not exceed the maximum occupant load designated in the Certificate of
Occupancy issued by the Department of Building and Safety, or in the absence of
such certificate, the maximum occupant load approved by the Chief.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.1004.5.1.1.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.1004.5.1.1.2
TITLE: PLANS REQUIRED.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
To determine occupant load and exit requirements, floor plans shall be
submitted to the Chief for the proposed occupancy. Such plans shall be drawn to
scale and shall show all seats, tables, furnishings, equipment, and all aisles,
cross aisles, and exit doorways in accordance with this chapter. An approved
floor plan for the occupancy shall be on the premises and available for
inspection by the Chief. The approval date on the floor plan shall coincide
with the approval date on the posted occupant load sign.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.1004.5.1.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.1004.5.1.2
TITLE: OCCUPANT LOAD RESPONSIBILITY.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 105.6
CONTENT:
No manager or person in control thereof shall admit to any assembly
occupancy or premises a greater number of persons than that for which the exit
facilities are designed or maintained or a greater number than the maximum
occupant load stated as a condition of any permit required by Section
57.105.6.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.1004.9.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.1004.9.1
TITLE: MULTIPLE USES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Areas within a place of assemblage having multiple uses shall have the
maximum number of occupants for each use posted.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.1004.9.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.1004.9.2
TITLE: MAINTAINING OCCUPANT LOAD SIGNS AND FLOOR PLANS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The manager or person in control of any place of assemblage shall be
responsible for maintaining the occupant load signs and floor plans.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.1004.9.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.1004.9.3
TITLE: COMPLIANCE WITH OCCUPANT LOAD.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The manager or person in control of any place of assemblage shall not permit
more persons in attendance than that number of occupants shown on the approved
occupant load sign.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.1004.9.4
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.1004.9.4
TITLE: REQUIRED SIGNAGE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 1004.9, 1004.9.4
CONTENT:
A sign entitled “Occupant Load” shall be provided by the owner, manager, or
person in control, or by the Department, subject to approval by the Chief, and
shall contain the following information:

In accordance with Sections 57.1004.9 through
57.1004.9.4, of Chapter 5 of Article 7 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code. This
assembly room or area is approved for the following use(s) and the maximum
number of occupants shall not exceed that shown:

Use
Number of Occupants
Address of Occupancy
Assembly Room Designation
Date approved
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.1004.9.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code

TITLE: SIZE OF LETTERS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The words on the sign designating occupant load, the use, and the number of
occupants shall be in letters not less than 1/2-inch in height.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.1004.10
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.1004.10
TITLE: OVERCROWDING.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
No manager or person in control of any assembly occupancy or premises shall
allow an overcrowded condition to exist in that assembly occupancy or premises.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.1004.10.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.1004.10.1
TITLE: OVERCROWDED CONDITION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: true
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null

No person shall remain in any building or premises that is overcrowded when

---

---

Chapter 9 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (Building Code).
---

TITLE: DOUBLE-ACTING DOORS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 100
CONTENT:
Double-acting doors shall not be used as exits when any of the following
conditions exist:

1. The occupant load served by the door is 100 or more.

2. The door is part of a fire assembly.

3. The door is part of a smoke and draft- control assembly.

4. Panic hardware is required or provided on the door.
---

---

200 square inches.
---

---

CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.1010.2.7.1

CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.1030.6.4
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.1030.6.4
TITLE: DISPLAYS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 000
CONTENT:
In areas used for display of equipment, booths, or similar uses, aisles
shall be provided as follows:

1. Areas containing less than 5,000 square feet of usable floor space
shall be provided with 6 feet wide aisles arranged so as not to exceed the
distance of travel requirements of this section.

2. Areas containing 5,000 to 30,000 square feet of usable floor space
shall be provided with 8 feet wide aisles arranged so as to not exceed the
distance of travel requirements of this section.

3. Areas containing more than 30,000 square feet of usable floor space
shall be provided with 10 feet wide aisles arranged so as to not exceed the
distance of travel requirements of this section.

4. Aisles that are provided for the convenience of persons in attendance
and are not required for exit purposes may be reduced below the required aisle
width by 2 feet.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.1030.13.1.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.1030.13.1.3
TITLE: SPACING OF TABLES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Tables shall be arranged so that the seating edges of adjacent tables are
not less than 54 inches apart. Rectangular tables arranged to accommodate
seating on one side only shall have not less than 36 inches between adjacent
table edges.
---

SKIP: false

CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.1104.16.4
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.1104.16.4
TITLE: ACCESS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Access to fire escapes shall be any one of the following:

1. Through a room between the corridor and the fire escape if the door to
the room is capable of being opened from the corridor side without the use of a
key, tool, or special knowledge or effort, or by an alternate method of access,
as determined by the Chief.

2. By a door capable of being opened to a fire escape from the interior
without the use of a key, tool, or special knowledge or effort, as determined
by the Chief.

3. By a window capable of being opened from the interior without the use
of a key, tool, or special knowledge or effort, as determined by the Chief.
Such window shall have a minimum dimension of 29 inches when open. The sill
shall be not more than 30 inches above the floor and landing.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.1104.16.7.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.1104.16.7.1
TITLE: USE OF FIRE ESCAPE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
No person shall attach or fasten, or cause to be fastened, to any part of
any fire escape, any rope, wire cable or similar device, except approved
standard equipment, nor shall any person store or maintain anything upon any
part of any fire escape.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.1104.16.8
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.1104.16.8
TITLE: PROTECTION OF EXTERIOR OPENINGS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
When a fire escape is designated as one of the required exits from a
building, the openings onto the fire escape landing and other openings within 5
feet horizontally of the landing shall be protected in a manner acceptable to
the Chief.
---

with the following exceptions, modifications, and additions.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2001.2.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2001.2.1
TITLE: STANDARD.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 407
CONTENT:
Any activity pertaining to airports, heliports and aircraft fuel servicing
not specifically regulated by this chapter shall comply with NFPA 407.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2001.3.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2001.3.1
TITLE: PERMITS REQUIRED.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 105.6, 105.7, 119
CONTENT:
A valid permit from the Department is required, in accordance with Section
57.105.6, when a building or premises is used as an aircraft fueling station,
private airport, or heliport. Further, a valid permit and general approval is
required, in accordance with Sections
57.105.6,
57.105.7 and
57.119, for an aircraft fuel servicing tank vehicle designed and operated for
the purpose of fueling aircraft on the grounds of an airport or heliport.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2002
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2002
TITLE: DEFINITIONS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 2002
CONTENT:
Section 2002 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2003
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2003
TITLE: GENERAL PRECAUTIONS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 2003
CONTENT:
Section 2003 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety with the following
exceptions, modifications, and additions.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2003.1.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2003.1.1
TITLE: WELDING AND CUTTING OPERATIONS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 105.8
CONTENT:
Whenever welding and cutting operations are conducted on an airport or in an
aircraft factory or hangar, a Special Permit in accordance with Section
57.105.8 shall be obtained from the Chief and shall comply with the
requirements of Chapter 35.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2003.6.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2003.6.1
TITLE: COMBUSTIBLE STORAGE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
No person shall store combustible materials, flammable liquids, flammable or
liquefied compressed gas cylinders (other than fire protection equipment) or
other hazardous materials in an aircraft factory or hangar, except in Hazardous
Materials Storage Rooms or as otherwise permitted by this article.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2003.8
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2003.8
TITLE: DRIP PANS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Every aircraft factory and hangar shall be equipped and maintained with
metal drip pans under the engines of all aircraft stored therein.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2003.9
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2003.9
TITLE: PESTICIDES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
No person shall store, mix or transport a pesticide or insecticide at any
airport except in connection with the application of such pesticide or
insecticide within the limits of airport facilities, or when such pesticide or
insecticide constitutes air freight and is stored and transported in
conformance with all applicable State and Federal regulations.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2004
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2004
TITLE: AIRCRAFT MAINTENANCE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 2004
CONTENT:
Section 2004 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety with the following
exceptions, modifications, and additions.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2004.8
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2004.8
TITLE: AIRCRAFT FUEL SYSTEM MAINTENANCE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 2004.8.1, 2004.8.6
CONTENT:
Maintenance of aircraft fuel systems shall comply with Sections
57.2004.8.1 through
57.2004.8.6.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2004.8.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2004.8.1
TITLE: FUEL TANK ATMOSPHERE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Any person conducting aircraft servicing, maintenance, or testing of the
fuel system using the air ventilation procedures, shall reduce the fuel tank
atmosphere to below 20% of the lower flammable limit of the fuel vapors. Air
ventilation, as used herein, means to pass undiluted air (air not containing
flammable vapors) through an aircraft fuel tank to render the atmosphere of the
tank below the lower flammable limit of the fuel vapors involved. Before any
inspection or work is performed, tests by a qualified person shall be conducted
to determine that the presence of flammable vapors in or around the fuel tank
does not constitute a fire or explosion hazard. This condition shall be
maintained throughout the period of inspection or work.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2004.8.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2004.8.2
TITLE: OPEN FLAME.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
All open flame and spark producing devices within flammable vapor areas
shall be shut down and shall not be operated while air ventilation is
occurring.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2004.8.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2004.8.3
TITLE: ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Electrical equipment used in the flammable vapor areas shall be approved for
use in Class I, Group D, Division 1 Hazardous Locations, as defined in
Chapter 9 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (Electrical Code).
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2004.8.4
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2004.8.4
TITLE: GROUNDING AND BONDING.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
To guard against static spark hazard, exhaust equipment and the aircraft to
be ventilated shall be electrically bonded and adequately grounded. If ducting
is used, a static bonding wire shall be connected from each exhaust hose nozzle
to the aircraft wing before opening the fuel tank.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2004.8.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2004.8.5
TITLE: ELECTRICAL CIRCUITS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Aircraft electrical circuits which are in flammable vapor areas shall be de-
energized.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2004.8.6
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2004.8.6
TITLE: WARNING SIGNS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Suitable warning signs shall be placed in conspicuous locations around the
aircraft to indicate that tank ventilation is in progress.
---

---

CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code

---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2203.3.1.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2203.3.1.3
TITLE: DUST COLLECTION SYSTEMS FOR ROOMS OR BUILDINGS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Every plant, factory, workshop, or other premises in which dust is produced,
or is a by-product, in such quantities as to create a hazard, shall be equipped
with an approved pneumatic or mechanical dust collection system designed,
maintained, and operated to keep all hazardous accumulations of dust from such
premises, including all enclosed and inaccessible areas and spaces.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2203.5.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2203.5.1
TITLE: HOUSEKEEPING AND MAINTENANCE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
No person shall permit the accumulation of any flammable or explosive dust
in quantities sufficient to create a fire or explosion hazard on floors, walls,
ledges, or other exposed building structural members, piping, conduit,
electrical equipment, or on the roof of any building on which dust may settle.
Metallic dust shall be stored in tightly covered metal containers in a cool,
dry place.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2204
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code

---

---

CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2205
TITLE: STANDARDS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 2205
CONTENT:
Section 2205 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2205.1.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2205.1.2
TITLE: DUST-TIGHT ENCLOSURES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
All dust producing or dust agitating machinery, such as grinding mills and
separators, and all elevators, elevator legs, spouts, hoppers, and other
conveyors shall be provided with casings or enclosures maintained as nearly
dust-tight as possible.
---

accordance with methods approved by the Chief and shall only be done using

---

---

CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code

TITLE: FLAMMABLE AND COMBUSTIBLE LIQUID MOTOR FUEL-DISPENSING
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null

CONTENT:

---

CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2307

APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 2307
CONTENT:
Section 2307 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety with the following

---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2307.9
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2307.9
TITLE: FILLING OF MOBILE FUEL TANKS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 105.6, 105.7
CONTENT:
Mobile fuel tanks shall be filled only at an auto fueling station having a
valid permit issued by the Chief. Mobile fuel tanks shall be filled only by the
permittee or persons instructed in methods of proper use and operation and who
are qualified to use liquefied flammable gas dispensing apparatus. Each
qualified operator shall be required to carry on them an identification card
issued by the permittee verifying the operator’s competence.

EXCEPTION: The transfer of liquefied flammable gas from a tank vehicle into
mobile fuel tanks of motor vehicles or equipment may be performed under permit
from the Department pursuant to Chapter 1, Sections
57.105.6 and
57.105.7, provided:

1. The transfer operation is not performed where the public is invited or
where there is unusual exposure to life and property.

2. The tank vehicles are approved by the Chief.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2308
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2308
TITLE: COMPRESSED NATURAL GAS MOTOR FUEL-DISPENSING FACILITIES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null

CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code

TITLE: STANDPIPES REQUIRED INTERVALS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 200
CONTENT:
Approved standpipes and hoses shall be provided and located in weather-
resistant cabinets at every marine service station, and not to exceed 200-foot
intervals on other piers and wharves. Hose stations shall provide protection to
all portions of docks, piers, wharves or floating craft.
---

57.105.7 shall be regulated under Special Permit from the Chief pursuant to
Section
57.105.8.

CONTENT:
Section 2403 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety with the following
exceptions, modifications, and additions.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2403.3.5.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2403.3.5.3
TITLE: CLEANING SOLVENTS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 100
CONTENT:
The use of flammable solvents for cleaning operations is prohibited.
Solvents for cleaning operations shall have flash points above 100°F. All
cleaning operations inside the spray booth shall be conducted with the
ventilation system in operation.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2403.3.7
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2403.3.7
TITLE: HANDLING OF CLASS I, II AND IIIA LIQUIDS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Original closed containers, approved portable tanks, safety cans, or
properly arranged and constructed piping systems shall be used for bringing
Class I, II and IIIA liquids into the spray area. Open or glass containers are
prohibited.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2403.4.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2403.4.5
TITLE: REPAIR.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
No person shall make any alterations or repairs thereon or thereto, nor
permit them to be made, before any such rooms, booths or tunnels and all
equipment, ducts and pipes in connection therewith have been thoroughly cleaned
of residue and made gas and vapor free.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2404
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2404
TITLE: SPRAY FINISHING.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 2404
CONTENT:
Section 2404 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety with the following
exceptions, modifications, and additions.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2404.3.2.3.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2404.3.2.3.1
TITLE: FLOOR COVERING.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
All combustible flooring under and adjacent to spray booths or spray tunnels
shall be protected with a covering of noncombustible material so installed as
to prevent the combustible flooring from coming into contact with the flammable
liquids used in the spraying process, and of such a nature as to facilitate the
safe cleaning and removal of residues.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2404.6.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2404.6.3
TITLE: HEATING SPRAY BOOTHS AND SPRAY ROOMS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 120
CONTENT:
No heating device shall be located, installed, maintained or used in any
spray room. For comfort of persons working within the spray room or spray
booth, heating appliances of indirect type may be installed on the outside of
such booths or rooms for the purpose of introducing heat inside thereof,
provided the temperature does not exceed 120°F at the warm air inlet to the
booth or tunnel and that location and arrangement of the heating appliance and
the method of heat introduction into said room is first approved.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2404.7.9
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2404.7.9
TITLE: EXHAUST DUCTS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 2404.7.9.1, 2404.7.9.6
CONTENT:
Exhaust ducts shall be in accordance with Sections
57.2404.7.9.1 through
57.2404.7.9.6.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2404.7.9.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2404.7.9.1
TITLE: GAUGE OF METAL.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 2404.7.9.1
CONTENT:
Every duct or pipe shall be constructed of galvanized metal sheets in
accordance with the provisions of
Table 57.2404.7.9.1.

TABLE 57.2404.7.9.1
SPRAY EXHAUST DUCTS – GAUGE OF METAL


Duct Cross-Sectional Dimension in Inches Gauge of Duct Metal
Up to 8 24
Over 8 inches to 18 22
Over 18 inches to 30 20
Over 30 18
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2404.7.9.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2404.7.9.2
TITLE: SEAMS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
All seams in any duct or pipe shall be made tight by crimping or other
equally efficient manner without the use of solder or combustible materials,
and all sections shall be securely joined.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2404.7.9.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2404.7.9.3
TITLE: INSULATING.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Exhaust ducts shall have a clearance from unprotected combustible
construction or other combustible material of not less than 18 inches. This
distance may be reduced if protection is provided for all combustible surfaces
within 18 inches according to the following schedule:

1. 28 gauge sheet metal on 1/4-inch insulating millboard 12 inches.

2. 28 gauge sheet metal on 1/8-inch insulating millboard spaced out 1 inch
on noncombustible spacers 9 inches.

3. 22 gauge sheet metal on 1-inch rockwool bats reinforced with wire mesh
or the equivalent 3 inches.

4. Any other approved material of equal of greater fire-resistance.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2404.7.9.4
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2404.7.9.4
TITLE: SEPARATION FROM COMBUSTIBLE MATERIAL.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Ducts or pipes may be separated from combustible material by a ventilated
collar which provides a clear air space equal to one-half the diameter of the
duct, but in no event shall such collar provide less than 3-inch air space, and
such collar shall extend not less than 12 inches above and below such
combustible material.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2404.7.9.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2404.7.9.5
TITLE: BRANCH DUCTS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Every branch duct or pipe shall be connected to the main duct or pipe at an
angle not exceeding 45 degrees measured from the centerline of the main duct or
pipe. Every bend, turn or elbow in any duct or pipe shall be constructed so as
not to reduce the cross sectional area of the duct or pipe. Every change in
cross section of any such duct or pipe shall be by means of a transition
fitting having a slope or taper of not more than 1 inch for each 4 inches in
length of the said duct or pipe.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2404.7.9.6
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2404.7.9.6
TITLE: DUCT VELOCITY.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Exhaust ducts shall be designed to provide sufficient air transport velocity
to prevent the over-spray from settling in the duct.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2405
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2405
TITLE: DIPPING OPERATIONS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 2405
CONTENT:
Section 2405 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety with the following
exceptions, modifications, and additions.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2405.2.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2405.2.1
TITLE: LOCATION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 500
CONTENT:
No dip tank shall be located, installed, maintained, or used in any building
or room except in an approved location. Tanks in excess of 500 gallons shall
not be located in or above basements.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2405.12
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2405.12
TITLE: PROTECTION OF FLOORS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Dip tanks exceeding 20-gallon capacity shall not be used or maintained on
any combustible floor. Dip tanks of 20-gallon capacity or less shall not be
used or maintained on combustible flooring unless the floor under such tanks,
and for a distance of 5 feet on all sides of dip tanks, drain boards, and
objects which have been dipped is protected with a covering of noncombustible
material in such a manner as to prevent the floor from becoming saturated or
covered with flammable or combustible liquids used in the dipping process.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2603.3.6
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2603.3.6
TITLE: WARNING AGENT.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 000
CONTENT:
Fumigation or pest-control operations involving any structure, ship, or
tarpaulin-covered area in which a chemical is used which does not give adequate
warning of dangerous and lethal concentrations, shall require the use of
Chloropicrin in conjunction with such operations. The Chloropicrin shall be
applied at the rate of one ounce per 15,000 cubic feet of space or portion
thereof. The Chloropicrin shall be so used as to permit penetration to all
spaces under fumigation. This shall be done at least 30 minutes prior to
application of the fumigant. A California licensed fumigator shall supervise
all fumigation operations, and shall determine that all areas under fumigation
have been so permeated by Chloropicrin as to render them humanly untenable
before leaving the premises.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.2603.3.7
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.2603.3.7
TITLE: FIRE DEPARTMENT NOTIFICATION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
At least 24 hours prior to conducting any fumigation, written notice shall
be given to the Los Angeles Fire Department Metropolitan Fire Communications,
of the date, place, and name of fumigator, extent or duration of fumigation,
name of fumigant, and sealing method used, except that notification is not
required where fumigation is to be done in approved chambers, nor in the case
of tarpaulin fumigation of structures or trees.
---

CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.3104.11.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.3104.11.1
TITLE: RESPONSIBILITY OF OWNER OR MANAGER.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 3104.14
CONTENT:
The owner or manager of any tent or membrane structure shall be responsible
for limiting the occupant load in that tent or membrane structure in accordance
with Section
57.3104.14.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.3104.17.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.3104.17.3
TITLE: FIRE SAFETY OFFICER.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 104.18, 500, 000
CONTENT:
A Fire Safety Officer shall be provided in accordance with Section
57.104.18 and the following conditions:

1. Occupant loads of 500 or more shall require a minimum of one Fire
Safety Officer.

2. Each additional 1,000 occupants, or fraction thereof, shall require one
additional Fire Safety Officer.

3. Filming inside tents requires Fire Safety Officers.

EXCEPTION: The Chief may modify or approve an alternate method of compliance
with this section if minimum life safety requirements are met.
---

CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.1
TITLE: GENERAL.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The provisions of this section and applicable provisions of Titles 19 and
24, C.C.R. shall regulate fire and life safety requirements for assembly
occupancies. Such provisions apply to all assembly occupancies requiring a fire
permit and define who shall be responsible for providing the fire and life
safety within. The provisions recognize that life safety consists of more than
exit requirements alone and address the proper use of decorative materials,
open flame, flammable liquids and gases, and the operation of motion picture
theaters and projection rooms. The provisions do not address building
construction features that are regulated by
Chapter 9 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (Building Code).
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.2
TITLE: PERMIT REQUIRED.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
A permit is required to engage in the business of operating a place of
assemblage or to temporarily use a building or part thereof or premise as a
place of assemblage.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.2.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.2.1
TITLE: BUSINESS OPERATING A PLACE OF ASSEMBLAGE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 105.6.5
CONTENT:
No person may engage in the business of operating a place of assemblage
without a valid permit issued from the Chief in accordance with Section
57.105.6.5.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.2.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.2.2
TITLE: TEMPORARY PLACE OF ASSEMBLAGE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 105.7.1.3, 105.6.5
CONTENT:
No person may use a building or premise as place of assemblage without a
valid permit issued from the Chief in accordance with Section
57.105.7.1.3.

EXCEPTION: A building or premise with an existing permit under Section
57.105.6.5 that does not exceed its operating restrictions.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.2.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.2.3
TITLE: FAILURE TO COMPLY.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 105.5, 105.6.5, 105.7.1.3
CONTENT:
Pursuant to Section
57.105.5, the failure to comply with any provision of this article may result
in the denial, suspension, or revocation of a permit issued under Sections
57.105.6.5 and
57.105.7.1.3.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.3
TITLE: MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITY.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The owner, manager, or person in control of any assembly occupancy shall be
responsible for compliance with the fire and life safety provisions of this
chapter. The person in control of any assembly occupancy shall, upon request of
the Chief provide the name, address, and telephone number of the owner,
manager, representative, or lessee. Every place of assemblage shall be under
the constant supervision of the owner, manager, or a person in control who
shall be on the premises during the time that the occupancy is open to the
public.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.3.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.3.1
TITLE: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS FOR TEMPORARY PLACE OF ASSEMBLAGE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 105.7.1.3, 1001, 1031, 106.1.3.1
CONTENT:
In addition to other requirements in this article, the owner, manager, or
person in control of an assembly event operating pursuant to a permit under
Section
57.105.7.1.3 shall meet all of the following minimum requirements:

1. Before the issuance of the permit, provide to the Department
documentation that all fire protective systems within the building or premise
have been maintained and are functioning properly;

2. Before the issuance of the permit, provide to the Department a valid
certificate of occupancy issued by the Department of Building and Safety for
the applicable building;

3. Be physically present and provide constant supervision at the building
or premise during the time that the assembly event is open to the public;

4. Comply with Chapter 8 of the California Fire Code and CCR Title 19, and
provide flame certifications for all fabrics and decorations;

5. Provide and maintain exits, seating arrangements, exit signs, occupant
loads, and access facilities in accordance with Sections
57.1001 through
57.1031; and

6. If an assembly event includes stages or platforms more than 30 inches
above grade or temporary structures higher than 12 feet, procure a separate
Temporary Installation permit in accordance with Section
91.106.1.3.1.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.4
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.4
TITLE: EXIT & ACCESS FACILITIES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The person in control of any assembly occupancy shall provide and maintain
exits, seating arrangements, exit signs, occupant loads, and access facilities
in accordance with Chapter 10 of this article.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.4.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.4.1
TITLE: OBSTRUCTION OF EXIT FACILITIES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 4701.4.1.1, 4701.4.1.4
CONTENT:
In addition to the exiting requirements found in Chapter 10 of this article,
assemblage occupancies shall also comply with Sections
57.4701.4.1.1 through
57.4701.4.1.4
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.4.1.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.4.1.1
TITLE: OBSTRUCTION OF EXITS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
No person shall maintain or place any chair, table, stool, sofa, settee,
booth, easel, camera, microphone, cable, false front, rope barrier, or other
obstruction except a breakaway rope necessary to control and maintain order in
any exit of any assembly occupancy while the same is open for business or while
there are persons other than employees therein.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.4.1.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.4.1.2
TITLE: OBSTRUCTION OF LOBBIES AND FOYERS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
No person shall maintain or place any chair, table, stool, sofa, settee,
booth, easel, camera, microphone, cable, false front, rope barrier, or other
obstruction which will reduce the required exit width in any lobby, foyer,
mezzanine, or other public area of any assembly occupancy while the same is
open for business or while there are persons other than employees therein,
except by written permission by the Chief.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.4.1.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.4.1.3
TITLE: OBSTRUCTION OF EXITS BY PERSONS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
No person shall block, impede, or obstruct any exit to a public way or any
access to a building, structure or premises, in such manner as to prevent or
interfere with the use of such exits or access by any person who is exiting or
entering said occupied assembly occupancy.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.4.1.4
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.4.1.4
TITLE: WAITING SPACES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
In theaters, restaurants, and similar places of assemblage where persons are
admitted to the occupancy at times when seats are not available for them and
are allowed to wait in a lobby or similar space until seats are available, such
use of the lobby or similar space shall not encroach upon the required clear
width of exits. Such waiting shall be restricted to areas other than the
required exit way. Maximum occupant load for waiting spaces shall be one person
for each 5 square feet of waiting space. Exits shall be provided in addition to
the exits specified for the main assembly area and shall conform in arrangement
with Chapter 10 of this article.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.5
TITLE: OPEN FLAME.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 105.8
CONTENT:
No person shall use an open flame upon any stage or platform, inside any
dressing room, or within the public area of any assembly occupancy, except by
authority of a Special Permit from the Chief pursuant to Section
57.105.8.

EXCEPTIONS:

1. Approved heating appliances.

2. Smoking in any area where smoking is permitted.

3. The use of candles as part of a religious ritual, ceremony, or service,
provided that such candles are located in a portion of a room, building, or
premises not normally occupied by any persons except those charged with
ministration duties, and provided that such candles are safely supported in a
manner approved by the Chief.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.6
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.6
TITLE: LIVE THEATRICAL PRODUCTIONS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 100, 105.7
CONTENT:
When the occupant load is 100 or more, no person shall operate or maintain
any live theatrical production utilizing scenery and/or settings, lighting, or
other stage dressing or paraphernalia, in any motion picture theater, theater
or little theater except by authority of a permit in accordance with Section
57.105.7.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.7
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.7
TITLE: UNVENTED PORTABLE HEATERS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 105.8
CONTENT:
No person shall operate, maintain, or allow to exist any unvented portable
fuel-burning heater in any assembly occupancy except by Special Permit from the
Chief pursuant to Section
57.105.8.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.8
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.8
TITLE: COMPRESSED GASES AND LIQUEFIED FLAMMABLE GASES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 4701.8.1, 4701.8.3
CONTENT:
Compressed gases or liquefied gases shall comply with Sections
57.4701.8.1 through
57.4701.8.3.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.8.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.8.1
TITLE: SPECIAL PERMIT REQUIRED.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 105.8
CONTENT:
No person shall, without a Special Permit from the Chief, pursuant to
Section
57.105.8, use or store compressed gases or liquefied flammable gases within any
assembly occupancy for demonstrations, exhibitions, trade shows, lectures or
any other purpose which, in the opinion of the Chief, would create a fire,
life, or panic hazard.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.8.1.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.8.1.1
TITLE: CONDITIONS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 105.8
CONTENT:
Special Permits from the Chief, pursuant to Section
57.105.8, shall specify the following conditions for the proper use or display
of compressed gases or liquefied flammable gases within any assembly occupancy:

1. Cylinders and their appurtenances shall be designed, fabricated,
tested, and maintained in accordance with Chapter 53 and Chapter 61 of this
article.

2. Cylinders shall be stored in a place and manner approved by the Chief.

3. The use or display of compressed gases or liquefied flammable gases
shall not exceed 30 consecutive days.

4. Liquefied flammable gas cylinders shall be installed in an upright
position and be secured to prevent movement.

5. Cylinders shall not be exposed to any heat above ambient temperature.

6. Cylinders equipped with protective caps shall, except when in use, have
the caps in place.

7. Cylinder valves shall be closed at any time the demand for gas ceases
so that pressure will not be maintained on any attached equipment.

8. The amount of gas and number of cylinders shall not exceed the amount
and number approved by the Chief for a specific location.

9. Not less than one 10B:C portable fire extinguisher shall be provided
and accessible at each location where open flame is used.

10. Liquefied flammable gas cylinders shall not exceed 5.76 gallons water
capacity in size.

11. Liquefied flammable gas cylinders shall not be filled with more than
50% of nominal charging capacity.

12. The total amount of liquefied flammable gas cylinders on the premises
shall not exceed 60 gallons at any time.

13. Liquefied flammable gas used for the preparation or warming of food
for retail sale is prohibited.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.8.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.8.2
TITLE: LIQUEFIED FLAMMABLE GASES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 750
CONTENT:
Liquefied flammable gas used for space heating shall be supplied from a fuel
cylinder located outside of and at least 10 feet from any assembly occupancy.
An approved heater and piping system shall be used. Flexible hose in length up
to 36 inches may be used if it is designed for a minimum bursting pressure of
1,750 psig, and such hose shall be marked with “L.P.-GAS” or “LPG” labeling.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.8.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.8.3
TITLE: REGULATING DEVICES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Cylinder pressure regulating devices shall be located adjacent to the
cylinder. Cylinders and regulating devices shall be located and protected to
prevent physical damage.
---

---

EXCEPTION: Public assembly occupancies with occupant loads below 1,000 may

from the Chief pursuant to Section
---

---

SECTION: 57.105.8
TITLE: Such permit shall be issued only if it is demonstrated to the
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential

behavior of the audience as demonstrated by the past history of like audiences
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.11
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.11
TITLE: CROWD MANAGEMENT.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 000, 105.6.5
CONTENT:
The owner, manager, or person in control of any assembly event with an
anticipated attendance of 1,000 or more persons must submit a crowd management
plan as part of the permit application for permits issued under Section
57.105.6.5 or Section
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.105.7.1.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.105.7.1.3
TITLE: The crowd management plan must be approved by the Fire Code
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Official before the permit is granted and must satisfy all the safety needs of
the assembly event, including the safety of persons in the area surrounding the
assembly event. At a minimum, the plan must demonstrate or contain the
following elements:

1. The layout of the event is satisfactory for the safe movement of the
crowd between different areas of the assembly event;

2. The contingency for entry at the start of the assembly event;

3. The contingency for exiting at the end of the assembly event;

4. The contingency for evacuation and evacuation safe locations;

5. The number and assignments of crowd management personnel; and

6. Safeguards against the development of dangerous levels of crowd
density.

In evaluating the adequacy of the crowd management plan, the Fire Code
Official shall consider the anticipated size, predictability, and behavior of
the audience as demonstrated by past history of like audiences.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4701.12
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4701.12
TITLE: MEDICAL PLAN.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 105.6.5, 105.7.1.3
CONTENT:
Except for assembly occupancies that are classified as Group A or Group E
occupancies, the Department has the authority to prescribe or require the
development of an approved medical plan for an assembly event for permits
issued under Section
57.105.6.5 or Section
57.105.7.1.3 where the Department determines that such event may adversely
impact the delivery of public safety services (e.g., the number of people in
attendance, diminishing access to buildings, structures, fire hydrants, fire
apparatus access roads, etc.) or where such gatherings adversely affect public
safety services of any kind. The failure to secure approval of a required
medical plan or to implement an approved medical plan may result in the denial,
suspension or revocation of a permit issued under Section
57.105.7.1.3.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4702.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4702.1
TITLE: PERMIT REQUIRED.

AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 105.6
CONTENT:
A valid permit in accordance with Section
57.105.6 is required when a building or portion of a building is used as a day
care or educational occupancy.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4702.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4702.2
TITLE: MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITY.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The owner, manager, or person in control of any private day care or
educational occupancy shall be responsible for providing and controlling the
fire and life safety provisions of this section. The person in control of any
private day care or educational occupancy shall, upon request of the
Department, furnish the name, address, and telephone number of the owner,
manager, representative, or lessee. Every private day care or educational
occupancy shall be under the constant supervision of the owner, manager, or
person in control. Either the owner, manager, or person in control shall be on
the premises of the occupancy during the hours the facility is open for
educational or day care purposes.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4702.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4702.3
TITLE: SPACE HEATING APPLIANCE LOCATION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Any fuel burning heating appliance in day care or educational occupancies
shall not be located closer than 10 feet from any required exit where only one
exit is provided. Space heating appliances shall be properly vented in
accordance with
Chapter 9 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (Mechanical Code) and applicable
provisions of Part 4, Title 24, C.C.R. Any heater located in an area occupied
by children shall have protective features incorporated into its design or a
protective guard, screen, or other means to eliminate accidental contact with
the heating appliance.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4702.4
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4702.4
TITLE: CLASSROOM AISLES AND SEATS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
A building or portion of a building used for educational purposes shall
provide seating arrangements and aisles leading to the required exits as
specified in Title 19, C.C.R. This provision shall apply to every elementary
and secondary school, high school, and every State-owned or State-occupied
community college, college, and university.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4702.4.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4702.4.1
TITLE: EDUCATIONAL OCCUPANCIES NOT REGULATED BY TITLE 19, C.C.R.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 100
CONTENT:
All educational occupancies not regulated by Title 19, C.C.R., including
privately owned vocational or trade schools, colleges, universities and
educational facilities provided by firms or companies for employees, shall
adhere to the following seating requirements:

1. Aisles: Aisles adjacent to rows of seats shall be not less than 22
inches in width. The width of the aisle on the corridor side of the room
adjacent to the exit door and leading from the front to the rear of the room
shall be a minimum width of 3 feet. The aisle along the window side of the room
shall be not less than 22 inches in width if there are no exit doors on that
side of the room. If exit doors are on each side of the room, an aisle with a
minimum width of 3 feet shall be maintained adjacent to each exit door.

2. Seats: In rooms having a seating capacity of 100 or more, loose seats,
folding chairs, or similar seating facilities that are not fixed to the floor
shall be bonded together in groups of not less than three nor more than seven.
The spacing and arrangement of seats shall conform to the requirements of
Chapter 10 of this article.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4702.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4702.5
TITLE: DAY CARE FACILITY FIRE CLEARANCE PRE-INSPECTION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 13235, 1596.750, 106.7.1.1
CONTENT:
As provided by Health and Safety Code Section 13235, a prospective State
licensee of a day care facility, as defined in Section 1596.750 of the Health
and Safety Code, may request a pre-inspection of the facility prior to final
clearance approval in connection with the issuance of such State license. A fee
equal to, but not exceeding, the actual cost of the pre-inspection services
shall be charged for the pre-inspection of these facilities. Such fee shall be
paid to the Department prior to the pre-inspection by the Department. The fee
shall be established in the same manner as provided for the establishment of
fees under Section
57.106.7.1.1.
---

---

AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 105.6

A valid permit from the Department is required in accordance with Section
57.105.6 when a building or portion of a building is used as an institutional
occupancy.

---

CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code

TITLE: MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITY.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The owner, manager, or person in charge of any institutional occupancy shall
be responsible for providing and controlling the fire and life safety
provisions of this section. The person in charge of any institutional occupancy
shall, upon request by the Chief, furnish the name, address, and telephone
number of the owner, manager, owner’s representative, or lessee. Every
institutional occupancy shall be under the constant supervision of the owner,
manager, or person in charge.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4703.3

APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Every institution as required by the Chief shall implement a written and
approved Fire/Life Safety Program which includes procedures for notifying the
Fire Department, procedures for the use of fire protection equipment, and an
emergency evacuation plan.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4703.3.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4703.3.1
TITLE: EMERGENCY PLANS, PROCEDURES, AND EVACUATION SIGNS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
All Emergency Plans, procedures, and evacuation signs shall be submitted to
the Fire Department for approval prior to implementation. The approved copy of
the Fire/Life Safety Program shall be available for review by the Chief.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4703.3.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4703.3.2
TITLE: FIRE DRILLS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Fire drills shall be scheduled and performed quarterly for each shift
implementing the fire/life safety emergency procedures. A written record shall
be kept on forms approved by the Chief of all such drills. Records shall give
the date and time of each drill held. Records shall be maintained for a period
of three years and be available for review by the Chief.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4703.3.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4703.3.3
TITLE: EVACUATION PLAN POSTED.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The evacuation plan shall be posted throughout the facility and shall
include the following minimum requirements:

1. Evacuation routes, including locations of exits.

2. The location of fire alarm pull stations.

3. The location of portable fire extinguishers and other fire protection
equipment.

4. The phone number of the Fire Department.

5. Designation of outside refuge areas where guests or patients are to
assemble after evacuation of the building.

6. Assignment of a responsible person to call the Fire Department upon
notification of any fire or upon the activation of any fire protection system.
---

---

CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The Fire/Life Safety Program shall be updated and approved annually. All
personnel shall receive approved training conducted by the Department or by a
health care facility instructor who is certified in accordance with Section
---

APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Portable electrical heating appliances shall not be used in any
institutional occupancy without the approval of the Chief. All gas fired
heating devices shall be connected to the gas supply by means of approved rigid
or semi-rigid piping. All heating appliances shall be provided with guards that
will provide protection against ignition of clothing and other combustible
material.
---

---

SKIP: false

CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Appliances employing open flame radiated heat shall have fixed and
substantially constructed metallic guards located not less than 10 inches from
the radiating flame, with guard members spaced not more than 2 inches apart.
---

---

CONTENT:
Cabinet type appliances that are not provided with an inner combustion
chamber and an air circulating space between the combustion chamber and the
outer shell shall have fixed and substantially constructed metallic guards
located not less than 3 inches from the shell and spaced not more than 2 inches
apart.

---

SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
All lights protruding from any wall or ceiling shall be provided with
suitable guards to prevent their accidental breakage or contact with readily
ignitable materials.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4703.6
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code

SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Portable electric appliances shall not be placed closer than 5 feet to wash
basins, bath tubs, showers, or other grounded surfaces.
---

Fire Clearance Safety Inspections shall be conducted in accordance with

57.4703.7.1 and
57.4703.7.2.

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4703.7.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4703.7.1
TITLE: PRE-INSPECTION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 13235, 1502, 1569.2, 106.7.1.1
CONTENT:
As provided by California Health and Safety Code Section 13235, a
prospective State licensee of a community care facility, as defined in Section
1502 of the California Health and Safety Code, or of a residential care
facility for the elderly, as defined in Section 1569.2 of the California Health
and Safety Code, may request a pre-inspection of the facility prior to final
clearance approval in connection with the issuance of such State license. A fee
equal to, but not exceeding, the actual cost of the pre-inspection services
shall be charged for the pre-inspection of these facilities. Such fee shall be
paid to the Department prior to the pre- inspection by the Department. The fee
shall be established in the same manner as provided for the establishment of
fees under Section
57.106.7.1.1.
---

---

APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 106.7.1.1, 13131.5
CONTENT:
The Department shall charge and collect a fee for the final clearance
approval inspection in connection with the issuance of a State license to
operate a residential care facility housing non-ambulatory elderly persons. The
fee shall be established in the same manner as provided for the establishment
of fees under Section
57.106.7.1.1, but shall not exceed any fee for such inspection established by
the State Fire Marshal pursuant to Section 13131.5(f) of the California Health
and Safety Code.
---

CONTENT:
In the event an apartment house has 16 or more dwelling units or a hotel has

The owner or manager of every apartment house in which there are 16 or more
dwelling units and every hotel in which there are 20 or more guest rooms shall,
upon request of the Chief, furnish in writing both the name, unit number, and
telephone number of the current responsible resident and the name, address, and
telephone number of the owner or manager. Such statement shall be signed by at
least two of the following: owner, manager, or responsible resident.
---

---

SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
If the owner does not reside upon the premises of any apartment house in
which there are less than 16 dwelling units or any hotel in which there are
less than 20 guest rooms, a notice stating the name, address, and telephone
number of both the owner and the owner’s agent in charge of the occupancy shall
be posted in a conspicuous place on the premises.
---

CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4704.4.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4704.4.1
TITLE: POSTING IN GUEST ROOMS IN HOTELS AND MOTELS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 4704.4.3
CONTENT:
Every owner, responsible resident, administrator, or manager of a hotel or
motel located in a building which is three or more stories in height, shall
cause the fire safety information specified in Section
57.4704.4.3 to be posted and maintained in a clear and legible condition
affixed as a notice separate and apart from any other notice at a conspicuous
location on the inside surface of the main exit door or adjacent building
surface from each guest room. The information shall be printed on a durable
material and permanently affixed so as to be easily readable to the occupant of
that guest room.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4704.4.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4704.4.2
TITLE: DISTRIBUTION IN DWELLING UNITS IN APARTMENT HOUSES AND
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 4704.4.3
CONTENT:
CONDOMINIUMS.

Every owner, responsible resident, administrator, manager, lessor or sub
lessor of an apartment house or condominium, any portion of which is three or
more stories in height, shall cause the fire safety information specified in
Section
57.4704.4.3 to be distributed. The distribution shall be to each occupant,
tenant, buyer, lessee, or sub lessee thereof, and shall be accomplished prior
to or at the time that person first occupies or enters into possession of the
premises. Each distribution shall be accomplished in such a manner to attract
the attention of the occupant to the fire safety information and to stress its
importance in the event of a fire.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4704.4.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4704.4.3
TITLE: FIRE SAFETY INFORMATION REQUIRED.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Fire safety information shall be printed in a clear, non- ornamental style
of type which is 12 points or larger in size. The fire safety information shall
provide the reader with the following instructions on actions to be taken in
case of fire:

1. How to call the Fire Department.

2. How to alert others and where to activate the fire alarm system.

3. How to be protected inside a room threatened by fire.

4. How to evacuate the building.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.4704.4.3.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.4704.4.3.1
TITLE: SMOKE DETECTOR INFORMATION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Smoke detector information shall be included in fire safety information and
shall state the following: “SMOKE DETECTORS ARE PROVIDED FOR YOUR PERSONAL
SAFETY. ANYONE WHO WILLFULLY AND MALICIOUSLY TAMPERS WITH, DAMAGES, BREAKS, OR
REMOVES ANY REQUIRED SMOKE DETECTOR SHALL BE GUILTY OF A MISDEMEANOR. ANY
PERSON WHO WILLFULLY AND MALICIOUSLY SENDS, GIVES, TRANSMITS, OR SOUNDS ANY
FALSE ALARM OF FIRE IS GUILTY OF A MISDEMEANOR.”
---
