CONTENT:
Section 5503 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5504
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5504
TITLE: STORAGE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5504
CONTENT:
Section 5504 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5505
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5505
TITLE: USE AND HANDLING.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5505
CONTENT:
Section 5505 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5601
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5601
TITLE: GENERAL.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5601
CONTENT:
Chapter 56 of the California Fire Code (CFC) is hereby adopted by reference
with the following exceptions, modifications, and additions, and Section 5601
of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety with the following exceptions,
modifications, and additions.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5601.9
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5601.9
TITLE: SOURCES OF IGNITION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Smoking, matches, open flames, spark-producing devices, and other sources of
ignition shall not be permitted inside of or within 50 feet of any facility
used for the storage of fireworks, smokeless powder, small arms ammunition, or
small arms primers.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5601.10
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5601.10
TITLE: VEGETATION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Any open storage area around a portable magazine shall be kept clear of
brush, dried grass, weeds, and other combustible materials for a distance of at
least 50 feet. Persons owning or having charge or control of the magazine shall
be responsible for maintaining required clearance.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5601.11
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5601.11
TITLE: FIRE PROTECTION PORTABLE FIRE EXTINGUISHERS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Fire protection portable fire extinguishers shall be provided as required by
Chapter 9 of this article wherever fireworks, smokeless powder, small arms
ammunition or small arms primers are stored, manufactured, or handled.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5601.12
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5601.12
TITLE: WARNING PLACARDS AND SIGNS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 105.6.17, 704
CONTENT:
Wherever fireworks, smokeless powder, small arms ammunition, or small arms
primers are stored in quantities over the exempt amounts as listed in
Table 57.105.6.17, warning placards designed and constructed as specified in
NFPA 704 shall be conspicuously posted in the following locations:

1. At the entrance to any building where such materials are stored, and at
such other locations as may be required by the Chief.

2. At the main entrance to any area outside a building where such
materials are stored, or within such area, if no entrance is clearly defined.

3. At such locations as required by the Chief.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5601.12.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5601.12.1
TITLE: POSTING.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Wherever fireworks, smokeless powder, small arms ammunition, or small arms
primers are stored, signs with letters at least 3 inches high on a contrasting
background stating “FIREWORKS,” “SMOKELESS POWDER,” “AMMUNITION,” and/or “SMALL
ARMS PRIMERS” appropriately identifying that type of material or materials
involved, shall be conspicuously posted at any location within a building and
at any location within an area outside a building where such materials are
stored, and also at such other locations as may be required by the Chief.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5602
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5602
TITLE: DEFINITIONS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5602
CONTENT:
Section 5602 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5603
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5603
TITLE: RECORDKEEPING AND REPORTING.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5603
CONTENT:
Section 5603 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604
TITLE: EXPLOSIVE MATERIALS STORAGE AND HANDLING.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5604
CONTENT:
Section 5604 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety with the following
exceptions, modifications, and additions.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.1.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.1.1
TITLE: BLASTING AGENTS – GENERAL.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The storage, processing, use or transportation of blasting agents shall be
regulated in the same manner as explosive materials.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12
TITLE: GENERAL PROVISIONS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5604.12.1, 5604.12.8.3
CONTENT:
Storage of explosive materials shall be in accordance with Sections
57.5604.12.1 through
57.5604.12.8.3.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.1
TITLE: ENCLOSED AND ENCASED.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
No person shall possess, keep or store any explosive material which is not
completely enclosed and encased in a tight metal, wooden, or fiber container,
except at one of the following locations:

1. A plant for the processing of explosive materials.

2. A laboratory.

3. During blasting operations.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.2
TITLE: OUTSIDE OF, OR ABOUT, THE CONTAINERS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
No person having any explosive materials in their possession or control
shall under any circumstances permit or allow any grains or particles of
explosives to be or remain on the outside of, or about, the containers in which
the explosive materials are kept.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.3
TITLE: STORAGE WHILE NOT BEING TRANSPORTED.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Except while being transported, containers of explosive materials shall be
kept or stored in an explosive vault or in an explosives magazine.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.4
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.4
TITLE: CUT OFF OF ESCAPE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
No explosive material shall be kept at any place where its accidental
discharge would cut off the escape of persons working therein..
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.5
TITLE: STORAGE OF BLACK BLASTING POWDER.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Black blasting powder shall not be stored with other Class “A” explosive
materials except in an explosives vault.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.6
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.6
TITLE: EXPLOSIVE VAULTS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5604.12.6.1, 5604.12.6.10
CONTENT:
Storage in explosive vaults shall be in accordance with Sections
57.5604.12.6.1 through
57.5604.12.6.10.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.6.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.6.1
TITLE: WHEN STORED.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Explosive materials shall be stored in an explosives vault.

EXCEPTION: Explosive materials in temporary storage for immediate use may be
stored in a portable magazine.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.6.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.6.2
TITLE: MAXIMUM QUANTITY.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 500
CONTENT:
Not more than 500 pounds of explosive materials shall be stored in any one
explosives vault.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.6.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.6.3
TITLE: CONSTRUCTION AND ISOLATION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Every explosives vault used for the storage of explosive materials shall be
constructed and isolated as set forth in
Chapter 9 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (Building Code), and located in
accordance with the provisions of
Chapter I of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (Zoning Code).
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.6.4
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.6.4
TITLE: SIGNAGE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
A legible printed sign with the words “EXPLOSIVES VAULT – DANGEROUS” in
letters not less than 6 inches high shall be posted in conspicuous locations on
each side of the entrance to any aboveground explosives vault and at the
entrance to any underground explosives vault.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.6.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.6.5
TITLE: SOURCE OF IGNITION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
No match, fire, or lighting device of any kind except an electric flashlight
or electric lantern shall at any time be taken into an explosives vault.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.6.6
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.6.6
TITLE: OPENING OF PACKAGE OR CONTAINER.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
No package or container of explosives shall at any time be opened in any
explosives vault.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.6.7
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.6.7
TITLE: IGNITERS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Igniters, detonators, fuses, boosters, or other initiating devices shall not
be stored in the same explosives vault with explosive materials.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.6.8
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.6.8
TITLE: ORDER OF REMOVAL FROM VAULT.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
When explosive materials or initiating devices (igniters, detonators, fuses,
etc.) are removed from an explosives vault, those which have been longest in
the vault shall be removed first.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.6.9
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.6.9
TITLE: MAINTENANCE OF EXPLOSIVES VAULT.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Explosives vaults shall be kept clean and free from rubbish. They shall not
be used for the storage of any material except explosive materials.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.6.10
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.6.10
TITLE: KEYS OR COMBINATIONS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Keys or combinations for explosives vault locks shall be kept in a safe
place. No unauthorized person shall unlock or remove explosive materials from
an explosives vault.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.7
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.7
TITLE: PORTABLE MAGAZINES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5604.12.7.1, 5604.12.7.7
CONTENT:
Storage in portable magazines shall be in accordance with Sections
57.5604.12.7.1 through
57.5604.12.7.7.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.7.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.7.1
TITLE: USE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Portable magazines may be used for the transportation or temporary storage
of explosive materials.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.7.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.7.2
TITLE: MAXIMUM OF EXPLOSIVE MATERIAL.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 100
CONTENT:
Not more than 100 pounds of explosive materials shall be stored or
transported in any one portable magazine.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.7.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.7.3
TITLE: MAGAZINE COLOR AND SIGNAGE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Portable magazines shall be painted red and shall bear lettering in white,
on all sides and top, at least 3 inches in height and having a 1/2-inch stroke
which reads: “EXPLOSIVES.”

EXCEPTION: Smaller lettering may be approved when the size of the magazine
prohibits the use of the larger lettering.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.7.4
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.7.4
TITLE: LOCATION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Portable magazines shall be so located and so protected as to prevent
accidental impact from vehicles or falling objects.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.7.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.7.5
TITLE: IGNITERS, DETONATORS, FUSES, BOOSTERS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Igniters, detonators, fuses, boosters, or other initiating devices shall not
be stored or transported in the same portable magazine with other explosive
materials.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.7.6
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.7.6
TITLE: SECURING WHEN NOT IN CONSTANT ATTENDANCE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Portable magazines left at locations where no persons is in constant
attendance shall be secured in place.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.7.7
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.7.7
TITLE: KEPT CLOSED AND SECURELY LOCKED.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Except when necessarily opened for use by authorized persons, portable
magazines shall be kept closed and securely locked at all times.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.8
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.8
TITLE: BLACK SPORTING POWDER.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5604.12.8.1, 5604.12.8.3
CONTENT:
The storage and display of black sporting powder shall be in accordance with
Sections
57.5604.12.8.1 through
57.5604.12.8.3.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.8.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.8.1
TITLE: APPROVED CONTAINERS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Black sporting powder shall be stored in shipping containers approved by the
United States Department of Transportation (DOT).
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.8.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.8.2
TITLE: STORAGE REQUIREMENTS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, commercial, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5003.8.7, 500
CONTENT:
Storage requirements are as follows:

1. Commercial stock of black sporting powder shall be stored indoors.

2. Quantities of more than one pound and not more than 20 pounds shall be
stored in an approved portable magazine constructed in accordance with Section
57.5003.8.7.

3. Quantities of more than 20 pounds and not more than 500 pounds shall be
stored inside an explosives vault that conforms to the requirements of
Chapter 9 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (Building Code).
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.12.8.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.12.8.3
TITLE: PRODUCT DISPLAY.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Display shall not be accessible to the public and shall be limited to one
pound maximum.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13
TITLE: TRANSPORTATION OF EXPLOSIVE MATERIALS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5604.13.1, 5604.13.9.2.5
CONTENT:
The transportation of explosive materials in any amounts, unless
specifically exempted herein, shall be in compliance with Sections
57.5604.13.1 through
57.5604.13.9.2.5.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.1
TITLE: EXCEPTIONS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5604.13.1.1, 5604.13.1.8
CONTENT:
Specific exceptions to the transportation of explosive materials are
provided in Sections
57.5604.13.1.1 through
57.5604.13.1.8.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.1.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.1.1
TITLE: RAIL COMMON CARRIERS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Rail common carriers transporting dangerous cargo in compliance with the
provisions of the United States Department of Transportation; and aircraft
complying with applicable regulations of the Federal Aviation Administration.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.1.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.1.2
TITLE: WITHIN A BUILDING.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Transportation within the confines of a room, building or plant.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.1.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.1.3
TITLE: SIGNALING DEVICES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Signaling devices, such as flares, colored lights, fuses or other devices
customarily used by railroads, public carriers, aircraft, and motor vehicles,
or torpedoes customarily used by railroads for signaling purposes.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.1.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.1.5
TITLE: CHEMICALS IN THE FORM OF MEDICINE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Chemicals in the form of medicine, when such chemicals are securely packed
in containers not exceeding 4 ounces in one outside package, and are prepared
in accordance with U.S. Pharmacopoeia Standards.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.1.6
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.1.6
TITLE: U.S. DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE, OR BY POLICE OR FIRE
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
DEPARTMENTS.

Transportation of explosive materials by the U.S. Department of Defense, or
by Police or Fire Departments in the performance of duty.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.1.7
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.1.7
TITLE: COMMON CARRIERS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 100
CONTENT:
Common carriers for hire shall be permitted to transport not more than 100
pounds of smokeless powder packaged in original United States Department of
Transportation containers, not exceeding 20 pounds in any single package, upon
any public highway not designated in regulations amended by the California
Highway Patrol as a route for the transportation of explosives.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.1.8
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.1.8
TITLE: COMPLIANCE WITH CALIFORNIA VEHICLE CODE AND THE CALIFORNIA
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
HEALTH AND SAFETY CODE.

Any vehicle regularly or temporarily used in carrying or transporting
explosive materials shall, in addition to the above provisions, be regulated by
and comply with the applicable provisions of the California Vehicle Code and
the California Health and Safety Code.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.2
TITLE: PERMITS AND FEES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: true
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 105.7
CONTENT:
Permits and fees shall be required as set forth in Section
57.105.7, except for vehicles operating under valid permit from the California
Highway Patrol, as required by the California Vehicle Code.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.3
TITLE: VEHICLES FOR TRANSPORTING EXPLOSIVES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The use of passenger vehicles for the transporting of explosive materials is
prohibited, except for the transporting of samples and other small quantities
not to exceed a total of 5 pounds.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.3.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.3.1
TITLE: REQUIREMENTS FOR VEHICLES USED FOR THE TRANSPORTATION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Vehicles used for the transportation of explosive materials shall be
equipped with springs, and have a solid floor with well-maintained interior
surfaces. Such vehicle shall have a sturdy wooden body with wooden sides and
ends and with no exposed ferrous metal on the inside thereof where explosive
materials are carried, except that portable magazines may be transported in
vehicles having exposed metal parts. The body shall be completely enclosed, or
shall be provided with a flame-resistant moisture-resistant tarpaulin for total
covering of all explosive materials carried.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.4
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.4
TITLE: EQUIPMENT REQUIRED.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5604.13.4.1, 5604.13.4.3
CONTENT:
Vehicles used for the transportation of explosive materials shall comply
with Sections
57.5604.13.4.1 through
57.5604.13.4.3.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.4.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.4.1
TITLE: SECURE LASHING.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Facilities shall be provided for securely lashing or bracing the load in
place.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.4.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.4.2
TITLE: WARNING PLACARDS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Warning placards designed and constructed as specified by the United States
Department of Transportation shall be displayed on each side, and at the front
and rear of vehicles carrying explosive materials.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.4.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.4.3
TITLE: PORTABLE FIRE EXTINGUISHERS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
At least two approved portable fire extinguishers shall be carried in
accessible locations on every vehicle. One extinguisher shall have a Class 2A
rating and the other shall have a Class l0B:C rating.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.5
TITLE: MAINTENANCE OF VEHICLES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Vehicles used for the transportation of explosive materials shall be
properly maintained, including brakes, headlights, warning devices, and other
parts thereof. The chassis, motor, body, and all other parts of the vehicle
shall be clean and free from surplus oil and grease. Gasoline tank and piping
shall be secure and without leaks. Electric wiring shall be completely
insulated and properly secured.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.6
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.6
TITLE: PROHIBITED ACTS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5604.13.6.1, 5604.13.6.5
CONTENT:
Acts listed in Sections
57.5604.13.6.1 through
57.5604.13.6.5 are prohibited.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.6.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.6.1
TITLE: FLAME-PRODUCING DEVICE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
No person shall carry matches, or any other flame-producing device, firearms
or loaded cartridges while on or near a vehicle loaded with explosive
materials.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.6.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.6.2
TITLE: TRAILERS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Explosives shall not be transported in a trailer, nor shall any trailer be
attached to any vehicle transporting explosives.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.6.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.6.3
TITLE: SMOKING OR USE OF MATCHES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
No person in, upon, or near any vehicle carrying explosive materials shall
smoke or light any match or otherwise have or produce any fire.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.6.4
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.6.4
TITLE: BLASTING CAPS OR DETONATORS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Blasting caps or detonators shall not be transported on the same vehicle
with other explosives.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.6.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.6.5
TITLE: UNATTENDED VEHICLE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
No motor vehicle transporting explosive materials shall be left unattended
upon any street or highway except in extreme emergency. Such vehicle shall be
deemed attended whenever the person in charge thereof is in or upon the
vehicle, or is in a position to observe the vehicle at all times.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.7
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.7
TITLE: SPECIAL OPERATING REQUIREMENTS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5604.13.7.1, 5604.13.7.6
CONTENT:
Special operating requirements shall comply with Sections
57.5604.13.7.1 through
57.5604.13.7.6.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.7.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.7.1
TITLE: ROUTES OF TRAVEL.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Every vehicle transporting explosive materials shall follow the routes of
travel designated in regulations amended by the California Highway Patrol and
pursuant to the California Vehicle Code.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.7.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.7.2
TITLE: HOURS OF TRANSPORTATION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Explosive materials shall not be transported during the hours of 7:00 a.m.
to 9:00 a.m., nor 4:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.7.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.7.3
TITLE: PARKING OR STOPPING.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Except in an emergency or as may be required by traffic regulations,
vehicles carrying explosive materials shall not be stopped or parked during the
course of transit until the point of delivery has been reached.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.7.4
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.7.4
TITLE: CONSTANT ATTENDANCE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
All vehicles or group of vehicles transporting explosive materials shall be
attended by at least one competent person.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.7.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.7.5
TITLE: LOAD LIMIT.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Explosive materials shall not be piled above the level of the sideboards or
tailgate of the body of the vehicle in which they are carried.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.7.6
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.7.6
TITLE: REPAIRS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Vehicles loaded with explosive materials shall not be taken into a garage or
other repair shop for repairs or storage.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.8
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.8
TITLE: EMERGENCY ACTION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
In the event of an accident involving any vehicle transporting explosives on
any public street or highway, the driver of the vehicle or other person in
charge shall immediately take action to safeguard and warn all persons who may
be endangered thereby, and notify the Fire Department as soon as possible.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.9
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.9
TITLE: PACKING AND LABELING.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5604.13.9.1, 5604.13.9.2.5
CONTENT:
Packing and labeling shall comply with Sections
57.5604.13.9.1 through
57.5604.13.9.2.5.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.9.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.9.1
TITLE: LABELING.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Every container of explosive materials offered for transportation shall bear
a label which complies with United States Department of Transportation
requirements.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.9.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.9.2
TITLE: PACKING.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5604.13.9.2.1, 5604.13.9.2.5
CONTENT:
Packing shall comply with Sections
57.5604.13.9.2.1 through
57.5604.13.9.2.5.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5604.13.9.2.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5604.13.9.2.1
TITLE: REASONABLE CARE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Every carrier of explosive materials shall exercise reasonable care to make
certain that all materials are safely and securely packed.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5605.10.2.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5605.10.2.1
TITLE: GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5605.10.2.1
CONTENT:
1. No unit or separate article of any manufactured or assembled explosive
material shall contain more than one- half pound of explosive material.

2. Emergency procedures shall be formulated for each plant and building.
Fire and disaster drills shall be conducted and records of such drills kept at
the plant office.

3. Employees who handle explosive materials shall be trained in the
hazards of the materials involved and processes in which they are to engage,
and shall be made familiar with the rules governing such materials and
processes.

4. Smoking is prohibited in locations where explosive materials are
present. Matches, lighters, smoking material and other sources of ignition are
not permitted in such locations.

5. Instructions for operators shall be posted at or near each working
area. Such instructions shall include amounts of explosive materials
permissible at the working area; number of persons permitted in the area at one
time; bonding of metal containers before pouring out contents; locking of
machinery in “off” position before working on it; cleaning agents to be used
(if any); and any other precautions deemed necessary due to characteristics of
the materials.

6. The quantity of explosive materials present in a work room shall not
exceed the amount necessary for current operations and in no case shall the
amount exceed a one-half day supply of explosive materials. Provided, however,
if in the opinion of the Chief a one-half day supply of explosive materials
would introduce an undue hazard, the maximum quantity may be limited to lesser
amounts.

7. The maximum amount of explosive materials contained at any one time in
any one building used for the manufacture or assembly of products utilizing or
containing explosive materials shall be limited to 80 pounds, not more than 20
pounds of which shall be contained in the building in other than partially
completed or completed product units.

8. The maximum permissible quantities of explosive materials allowed by
Subdivisions 6 and 7 of Section
57.5605.10.2.1 shall be clearly indicated with suitable signs with letters not
less than 3 inches high. No person shall allow the amount of explosive
materials in any one room or building to exceed the amount set forth upon the
posted sign for that room or building.

9. Explosive materials shall be kept in covered containers except when
being used or processed.

10. Waste receptacles with tight fitting covers shall be provided at or
just outside of each working area for the disposal of waste material, cleaning
rags, and other combustible waste and debris. Waste receptacles shall be
emptied and cleaned as often as necessary but at least at the end of each shift
or the end of each day.

11. Spilled or dropped explosives shall be cleaned up at once before other
operations are continued. Damaged or waste explosive materials, shipping
containers, cleaning rags, and other materials contaminated with explosive
materials shall be disposed of in accordance with the recommended practices
established by the manufacturer of the explosive materials used.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5605.10.2.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5605.10.2.2
TITLE: PROCESSING SAFEGUARDS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
1. Work areas shall be separated by distances, barriers, or other means so
that a fire at one area will not ignite material at another area.

2. Ventilation and dust-control equipment shall be of such type and so
installed and operated as not to endanger employees by possible ignition of
explosives. Ducts shall be grounded and as short and straight as possible with
no capped outlets, pockets, or other dead-end spaces where explosives might
accumulate.

3. Benches and other fixtures shall be of noncombustible materials;
provided, however, that static proof (conductive) coverings may be used.

4. Hydraulic and pneumatic presses, including hand jacks, shall be
provided with pressure relief valves so arranged and set that material in
process will not be subjected to pressures likely to cause it to explode. Dies
and plugged press equipment shall not be cleared by striking blows that may
cause the material to detonate or burn.

5. Mechanical screening, mixing, or blending operations involving
explosive materials shall only be carried on in isolated areas or buildings
used exclusively for such purposes, and, wherever practicable, such operations
shall be carried on with no personnel present during the period the machinery
is operating. At least one set of power controls shall be remotely located at a
safe point from the screening, mixing, or blending area. If the operation
requires the presence of employees, only the least practicable number of
employees shall be present, except that additional employees may be present for
purposes of instruction.

6. Means shall be provided whereby accumulated static electricity is
removed from hand trucks, buggies, and similar devices before they enter a
building or work area.

7. Wet processes shall be used wherever practicable in mixing explosive
materials.

8. Maintenance or repair work on machines shall not be done while
explosive materials are present in a building or work area; provided, however,
that this shall not prohibit minor adjustments or repairs where it would not be
practicable to clear the building or work area, nor shall it prohibit emergency
maintenance necessary to secure immediate safety.

9. Suitable exterior barricades, either natural or artificial, shall be
provided on pressure relief sides of building. Due consideration shall be given
to the effects of probable flying missiles with particular attention to the
safety of personnel.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5605.10.2.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5605.10.2.3
TITLE: TEST AREAS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
1. Areas where explosive materials are detonated or burned shall be fenced
and posted with adequate warning signs.

2. Audible and visible warning devices shall be utilized to give suitable
warning to nearby personnel before detonating or burning any explosive
materials.

3. When tests are being conducted or explosive materials are being
detonated or burned for any purpose, only authorized personnel shall be
permitted within the test area enclosure.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5605.10.2.4
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5605.10.2.4
TITLE: SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
All operations or activity on a site within which explosive materials are
used, stored, or handled shall be subject to such further additional or more
restrictive requirements or conditions as the Department may determine; these
may include requirements or conditions as to arrangements within buildings,
including requirements for protective structures or devices, rules and
regulations respecting smoking, fires, combustion of any kind, amounts and
arrangements of material number and qualifications of employees or other
persons on the premises, or any other condition, requirement, rule, or
regulation determined by the Department to be necessary or appropriate for the
protection of persons or property. Any such determination may be modified,
amended, or enlarged, or superseded as the Department may at any time
determine. The effective date and time of each determination shall be stated
therein and any determination which effects a change in one previously fixed
may be effective in 24 hours after service thereof, or later, as allowed by the
Department. Failure to comply with or obey any determination shall result in
the revocation of any permit held by the person to whom such determination is
addressed.
---

CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5607.16.4.4
TITLE: STACKING OF EXPLOSIVE MATERIALS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Explosive materials shall be stacked in piles not less than 25 feet from the
nearest holes being loaded and so spaced and distributed as to prevent
propagation of an explosion between any two piles in the event of a premature
detonation in any portion of the blast area.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5607.16.4.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5607.16.4.5
TITLE: EXPLOSIVE MATERIALS CONTAINERS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 100
CONTENT:
The explosive materials containers, if any, shall be opened at the pile and
carried up to the hole one case or unit at a time for immediate loading, or
placed at a loading station not less than 6 feet from the hole, except that not
more than 100 pounds of explosive materials shall be allowed at the loading
station at any one time.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5607.16.4.6
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5607.16.4.6
TITLE: SIMULTANEOUS DRILLING AND LOADING.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
When drilling and loading are being performed simultaneously in the same
area, the two operations shall be separated as widely as practicable and in no
case shall drilling be conducted closer to a loaded hole than a distance equal
to the deepest blast hole in the area.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5607.16.4.7
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5607.16.4.7
TITLE: POWER LINES AND PORTABLE ELECTRIC CABLES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 100
CONTENT:
Power lines and portable electric cables to equipment shall be kept a safe
distance away from explosive materials and loaded holes. Cables within 100 feet
of any hole which is loaded or being loaded shall be de-energized.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5607.16.4.8
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5607.16.4.8
TITLE: DRILL HOLES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
All drill holes shall be checked with a loading stick, dolly, or mirror
before loading operations are started to make sure the hole is opened for the
full depth.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5607.16.4.9
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5607.16.4.9
TITLE: DETONATORS USED IN FIRING BLASTS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Detonators, when used in firing blasts, shall have a strength of at least a
number six.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5607.16.4.10
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5607.16.4.10
TITLE: DETONATORS ENCASED.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The detonators shall be encased in explosive materials when inserted into a
drill hole, unless a safety primer is used.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5607.16.4.11
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5607.16.4.11
TITLE: FUNNEL.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
A funnel made of wood, nonferrous metal, or heavy paper shall be used to
load free-flowing or bulk explosive materials down a hole. The explosive
material shall be poured directly from its container through the funnel into
the hole.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5607.16.4.12
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5607.16.4.12
TITLE: WOODEN RODS USED FOR TAMPING.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Only wooden rods shall be used for tamping explosive materials and such rods
shall have no metal tips or parts other than non-ferrous metal ferrules for
extending the length of the wooden rod. The end of the tamping stick shall be
kept square and of such minimum diameter that the tamping stick will not by-
pass the cartridges in the hole.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5607.16.4.13
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5607.16.4.13
TITLE: TAMPING SHALL BE BY PRESSURE OR LIGHT BLOWS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
When loading explosive materials in a bore hole, tamping shall be by
pressure or light blows only and never by excessive ramming.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5607.16.4.14
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5607.16.4.14
TITLE: STEMMED TO THE COLLAR.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: true
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
All blast holes shall be stemmed to the collar or to a point to sufficiently
confine the charge and minimize the chance of injury to personnel by flying
material.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5607.16.4.15
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5607.16.4.15
TITLE: MECHANICAL TAMPING DEVICES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Mechanical tamping devices shall be so constructed that no metal parts will
enter the bore hole unless such parts are so effectively insulated that no
metal can come in contact with the explosive materiel being tamped.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5607.16.5
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5607.16.5
TITLE: BLASTING INSPECTION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The Chief shall inspect the proposed blasting operation prior to the
detonation of any explosive charge to be used in blasting. No detonation shall
be performed until the proposed blasting operation has been inspected and
approved by the Chief.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5607.16.5.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5607.16.5.1
TITLE: NOTIFICATION TO DEPARTMENT OF DETONATION TIME.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Every person in charge of a blasting operation shall notify the Department
of the estimated time of detonation. Such notification shall be made not later
than 4:00 p.m. of the last working day prior to the proposed date of
detonation, and in no case shall notification be made less than 24 hours prior
to the estimated time of detonation.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5608
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5608
TITLE: FIREWORKS DISPLAY.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5608
CONTENT:
Section 5608 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety with the following
exceptions, modifications, and additions.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5608.1.1.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5608.1.1.1
TITLE: ADDITIONAL – GENERAL.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5608.1
CONTENT:
In addition to the requirements set forth in Section 57.5608.1 for outdoor
fireworks displays, use of pyrotechnics before a proximate audience and
pyrotechnic special effects in theatrical and group entertainment productions,
the provisions of Chapter 56 shall also apply and be required.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5608.1.1.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5608.1.1.2
TITLE: ADDITIONAL SCOPE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5608.1.1
CONTENT:
In addition to the requirements set forth in Section 57.5608.1.1 for
fireworks and temporary storage use and handling of pyrotechnic special effects
material used in motion pictures, television and theatrical and group
entertainment productions, the provisions of Chapter 56 shall also apply and be
required.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5608.1.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5608.1.2
TITLE: FIREWORKS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
It shall be unlawful for any person to use, give, possess, sell, or
discharge any fireworks in the City of Los Angeles.

EXCEPTION : Patriotic, civic, and religious organizations may conduct
fireworks displays under permit by the Chief and in accordance with the
provisions of the California Health and Safety Code.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5608.1.2.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5608.1.2.1
TITLE: CONTROL AND SUPERVISION.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Every display shall be under the control and supervision of a Pyrotechnic
Operator licensed by the State Fire Marshal and shall be conducted under
conditions as required by the Chief. The fireworks in public displays shall be
located, discharged and of such character so as not to be hazardous to persons
or property.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5608.1.2.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5608.1.2.2
TITLE: FIREWORKS DISPLAY – ADDITIONAL LICENSE REQUIREMENT.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Every applicant for a permit to conduct a fireworks display shall submit
evidence of having a Fireworks Public Display License or a Fireworks General
Public Display License granted by the State Fire Marshal.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5609
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5609
TITLE: TEMPORARY STORAGE OF CONSUMER FIREWORKS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5609
CONTENT:
Section 5609 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety with the following
exceptions, modifications, and additions.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5609.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5609.2
TITLE: SHIPPING FIREWORKS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Fireworks may be shipped, delivered or sold for delivery to points outside
this City where the sale or use thereof is lawful, by any wholesaler, retailer,
jobber, warehouse workers, or a manufacturer, or manufactured for such sale or
distribution only, or kept in storage in a safe and secure place pending the
lawful disposal thereof; but no fireworks shall be handled, manufactured or
stored as set forth herein without the express written approval of the Chief.
Such approval shall be revocable for cause and shall be granted only upon
application therefor, setting forth a description of the place of storage or
manufacture and such other information as the Chief shall require.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5609.3
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5609.3
TITLE: STORAGE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5609.3.1, 5609.3.2
CONTENT:
Prior to shipping, legal display fireworks shall be stored in accordance
with Sections
57.5609.3.1 through
57.5609.3.2.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5609.3.1
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5609.3.1
TITLE: STORAGE IN HAZARDOUS MATERIALS STORAGE CABINET.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 500, 5003.8.7
CONTENT:
A maximum of 500 pounds of fireworks may be stored in a Hazardous Materials
Storage Cabinets pursuant to Section 57.5003.8.7 and in a location approved by
the Chief.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5609.3.2
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5609.3.2
TITLE: STORAGE IN EXPLOSIVE ROOMS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 500
CONTENT:
Quantities of fireworks in excess of 500 pounds shall be stored in a room of
one-hour fire-resistive construction. Door openings therein shall be protected
by one-hour fire assemblies. Such rooms shall be equipped with an automatic
sprinkler system.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5610
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5610
TITLE: EXPERIMENTAL ROCKETS/UNLIMITED.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5610
CONTENT:
Section 5610 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5611
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5611
TITLE: MODEL ROCKETS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential

AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5611
CONTENT:
Section 5611 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5612

SECTION: 57.5612
TITLE: EXPERIMENTAL HIGH-POWER ROCKETS AND MOTORS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential

AMENDMENT_OF: null

CONTENT:
Section 5612 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5613
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5613
TITLE: EMERGENCY SIGNALING DEVICES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5613

Section 5613 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5701
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5701
TITLE: GENERAL.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Chapter 57 of the California Fire Code (CFC) is hereby adopted by reference
with the following exceptions, modifications, and additions.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5702
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5702
TITLE: DEFINITIONS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5702
CONTENT:
Section 5702 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5703
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5703
TITLE: GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5703
CONTENT:
Section 5703 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety with the following
exceptions, modifications, and additions.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5703.7
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5703.7
TITLE: TRANSPORTING CLASS I OR II LIQUIDS WITHIN BUILDINGS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
Transportation of Class I or II liquids from storage rooms in buildings
shall be in approved containers not exceeding 60-gallon capacity. The handling
or use of Class I or II liquids in open containers is prohibited.

EXCEPTION: The above restrictions shall not apply to locations conforming to
Group H-1 and H-2 Occupancy requirements.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5703.8
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5703.8
TITLE: SPECIAL LIMITATIONS.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
The Chief may impose reductions or prohibitions on the amounts of flammable
or combustible liquids in storage or use when the Chief finds that an unusual
risk is involved by reason of undue hazards to life, a hazardous storage or
operation, unusual exposure, or multiple occupancy.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5703.9
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5703.9
TITLE: OTHER EMERGENCY FEATURES.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: null
CONTENT:
For every building or portion of a building where flammable or combustible
liquids are used, processed, or stored in such a manner as to give rise to
undue hazard of fire or explosion from flammable liquids or vapors, the
Department may require that such areas be provided with approved local exhaust
ventilation or general room ventilation, explosion venting, emergency drains,
curbs, warning systems, or approved fire extinguishing systems.
---

---
CHUNK_ID: LAMC-57.5704
CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
SECTION: 57.5704
TITLE: STORAGE.
APPLIES_TO: ADU, all, multifamily, residential
SKIP: false
AMENDMENT_OF: null
CROSS_REFERENCES: 5704
CONTENT:
Section 5704 of the CFC is hereby adopted in its entirety with the following
exceptions, modifications, and additions.
---

---

CODE_BODY: Los Angeles Municipal Code
